michael.t: hey all, day 1 question  need Vault access + a KMS-wrapped secret to run a quick integration demo with partner acct-444. what's the minimal flow?

anya.k: welcome! :wave: minimal flow: 1) request via @ops-bot with env/resource/reason/duration/target_account 2) infra queues it, 3) security reviews cross-account wrap, 4) you get ephemeral creds/ciphertext.

michael.t: can someone paste the exact request line I should use to the bot?

ops-bot: Template: `@ops-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/<team>/demo reason="<short reason>" duration_hours=2 wrap_key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/<key> target_account=acct-444 sensitive=true`

anya.k: notes: set duration as short as possible, mark sensitive=true for stricter audit, add SEC ticket id to any PR that references the secret.

sec-approver: prod or cross-account requests need two approvers (eng-security + product/owner). Rotation defaults: user sessions 8h, service secrets monthly auto-rotate. For KMS master keys follow compliance schedule (annual).

michael.t: submitted: `@ops-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/partner-demo reason="partner integration" duration_hours=3 wrap_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/demo/cryptoKeys/wrapKey target_account=acct-444 sensitive=true`

ops-bot: Request received. Ticket SEC-5566 created. Expect ~30-60m for cross-account review. For urgent requests ping @anya.k with ticket id.

anya.k: when you get the ciphertext, remember not to commit decrypted files. Use CLI to inspect: `vault kv get -field=value secret/team/redwood-inference/partner-demo` or use `gcloud kms decrypt` for the wrapped blob.

michael.t: got it, will wait and update the demo PR with SEC-5566. any tips if this needs to go prod later?

sec-approver: migrate to a service role, enable auto-rotation, and include a revocation runbook. We'll audit and attach prod owners during approval.

anya.k: welcome aboard! DM me if you want a 10min pairing session on the Vault/KMS tooling.
